classes.additive-safe: a new optional payload field (nullable or with a default), an `ensures` dropped, a call that is no longer idempotent: PATCH
classes.breaking: a service call, argument, sealed result, payload field or enum value removed or retyped: MAJOR
classes.needs-adapter: a new service call or argument, a new sealed result, a new required payload field, a new enum value, an `ensures` added or changed, a call that becomes idempotent: MINOR
classes.none: copy- or UI-only: the services surface is identical; the version is unchanged (SPEC_HASH still changes)
